KCB M-PESA is a savings and loan service in partnership with KCB Bank (a tier 1 Kenyan bank) that
enables M-PESA customers to save as little as KShs 1, and access credit from KShs 1,000.
The KCB M-PESA loan account is a micro-credit product which gives customers access to loans for an
emergency or to fund a project or an enterprise.
